description: The `x` and `y` attribute of `bn-chart-scatter` and `bn-chart-bubble`, in its JSON form.

step.description: Distance between two ticks. Default: a nice step for the size of the plot.

titlePosition.description: Where the title stands. `outside` (default): in a row of its own, above the plot for y and below the tick labels for x. `beside`: in two lines beside the end of the axis, left of the top of the y axis and right of the end of the x axis.

decimals.description: Decimals of the tick labels. Default: what the ticks need.

HighlightRange.description: Shaded band on one axis; open ends run to the domain edge.
